<b>Drapemites</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are crawlers covered in cloth that nest in rags and sheets that litter the dilapidated [[Citadel]]. They are the younger, smaller form of [[Giant Drapemite]]s.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Most Drapemites are disguised as rags among piles of rags and sheets, emerging once Hornet gets near, as indicated by rustling and dust being kicked up. They will walk towards Hornet between attacks, turning around at edges. Once Hornet is in range, they will use one of two moves:
* <b>Jumping Scratches:</b> Primes its gleaming claws and jumps at Hornet, swiping wildly for the jump's entire duration. If Hornet is caught by the attack at any point, she is comboed for {{Damage|1+1}}.
* <b>Retreat:</b> Scuttles backwards a set distance, ''often'' used as a followup to Jumping Scratches. Make sure to wait before dashing to prevent easily avoided contact damage.

Drapemites only deal {{Damage|1}} on contact.

If Hornet is out of range and far enough away, Drapemites will briefly walk back and forth before resuming their camouflaged form at a random location nearby.

Almost always encountered in tight passages, the most common option for escaping their flurry of scratches is to dash backwards. Immediately dashing back and attacking during the openings is often Hornet's only choice. Make sure to avoid getting cornered, and even use Silk Skills if necessary.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Drapemites have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Smell it, starving...
* Deeper, darker...
* Shriek and scratch them...
* Claw and fang...
* Find it. Take it...
* Hide below them...
}}

== Location ==
Drapemites can be found only in and around [[the Citadel]], primarily among rags and sheets in crawlspaces and shafts of [[the Slab]], [[Grand Gate]], [[Underworks]], [[Choral Chambers]], [[Cogwork Core]], and [[High Halls]]. They are found in great numbers in the [[Whispering Vaults]], disguised as rags among the furniture.
